"''It's good.|FN-0606 and FN-1226, under Rey's control|}} '''FN-1226''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[First Order]]'s [[FN Trooper Corps]] as a [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] in [[35 ABY]].According to ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] take place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]. The Hosnian Cataclysm was dated to [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' meaning Episode IX, in which FN-1226 appears, takes place in [[35 ABY]]. When [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] arrived on the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']] to rescue [[Chewbacca]], the young [[Jedi]] confused FN-1226 and [[FN-0606|another stormtrooper]] with a [[mind trick]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== FN-1226 first appeared in the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']] where he was played by [[J.D.
